metadata.description: Agent skills and plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: audit-and-improve
plugins.description: Deeply analyze a repository and produce an honest, evidence-based, severity-rated audit plus a prioritized improvement plan (Repo Map -> Audit -> Strategy -> Task Plan). Analysis-only; offers to execute the plan afterward.

plugins.name: mission
plugins.description: Structured execution framework for long-horizon coding tasks, built on Boyd's OODA loop. Decomposes projects into milestones with validation gates, fresh context per step, and file-based state.
